description: Measures Tensor Core throughput (TOPS) using WMMA 16x16x16 tiles for a tiled GEMM (D = A * B + C). Tests FP16 via rocWMMA/nvcuda::wmma, and TF32 on NVIDIA Ampere+ (sm_80+). Reports TOPS.

scaling_param.name: matrix_dim
scaling_param.description: Square matrix dimension M=N=K; must be a multiple of 16 (WMMA tile size)

non_scaling_params.name: warmup_iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Number of warmup kernel launches before timing

non_scaling_params.name: timed_iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed kernel launches for averaging
